title: Contributors
tagline: PR contribution to Coinbase AgentKit (integration with OpenSea marketplace)
description:
We are going to make an open-source contribution to Coinbase AgentKit, specifically by integrating the OpenSea marketplace. We got this idea from wishlist.md (https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit)

Users will be able to list their NFTs on the marketplace using natural language.

In this project, we are contributing to Coinbase’s chat system by integrating it with the renowned OpenSea platform. Our goal is to enhance the user experience by enabling seamless interaction with NFTs directly within the chat. Users can effortlessly browse their NFT collection from their wallet, select specific assets, and list them on OpenSea—all without leaving the interface. This integration streamlines the process, making NFT trading more accessible and intuitive.
